justifications.goal_fidelity: imas_codex/standard_names/review/jev_review.py:341 (check_failure_probability) and imas_codex/standard_names/fanout/trigger.py:44 (should_trigger_fanout_from_checks) implement the brief's items, with the caveat that imas_codex/standard_names/fanout/config.py:130's switch has no production reader.
